verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰ ਤਲਵਾਇਆ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਇ ਸਹਸ ਫਲ ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: sir talavaiaa birakh hai hoi sahas fal sufal fala(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: The head (root) of the tree remains downwards and there for it is laden with flowers and fruit.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਸਿਰੁ ਨੀਵਾ ਨੀਵਾਣਿ ਚਲੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: niramal neer vakhaaneeaai sir neevaa neevaan chala(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: The water is known as pure because it flows downward.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰ ਉਚਾ ਨੀਵੇ ਚਰਣ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਸੀਸੁ ਪਵੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: sir uchaa neeve charan gurmukh pairee sees pava(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: The head is higher and the feet lower but even then the head bows on the feet of the gurmukh.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭਦੂ ਨੀਵੀ ਧਰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਸੈ ਸਾਰੁ ਸਹੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: sabhadhoo neevee dharat hoi an dhan sabh sai saar saha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: The lowest is the earth which bears the burden of the whole world and of the wealth in it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਓਹੁ ਥਾਉ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਧੂ ਪੈਰੁ ਧਰੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: dha(n)n dharatee oh thaau dha(n)n gur sikh saadhoo pair dhara(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: That land and that place is blest where the Guru, the Sikh and ..he holymen put their feet.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਧੂੜਿ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਵੇਦ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਿ ਸੁਣੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: charan dhooR paradhaan kar sa(n)t vedh jas gaav suna(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: That the dust of the feet of the saints is the highest is told even by the Vedas.
Any fortunate one attains the dust of the feet.
